title: The 6-8-10 Right Triangle
description: Using a² + b² = c² to find the longest side of a right triangle with legs 6 and 8.
narration_lines: A right triangle has legs of 6 and 8. What's the longest side?
Square each leg: 6 squared is 36, 8 squared is 64.
The square root of 100 is 10, the longest side -- true for every right triangle, any size.

params.hook: A right triangle with legs 6 and 8?
